Bill.BriefDescription: Authorizing the use of video equipment in nursing homes.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the use of video equipment in nursing homes;adding a new section to chapter 18.51 RCW; and creating a new section.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: It is the intent of the legislature toenable nursing facilities to protect the safety of vulnerable adultsand improve the quality of services provided while respectingresidents' privacy.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 18.51 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: An administrator of a nursing facility licensed under this chaptermay authorize the use of video equipment to monitor and observe,through the use of video equipment, the perimeter, common areas,recreational areas, walkways, and any other areas frequented byresidents, staff, and visitors of the nursing facility.
